openings.claim: Movement-linked current locators may reduce second searches while retaining surname dividers and cart storage.
openings.discriminator: Accurate locations shorten searches; unchanged delays defeat sufficiency. Cart speed must survive matching volume and size.
openings.probe: Compare matched pickups, location accuracy, second searches and completion using existing paper.
openings.uncertainty: Benefits, sustainable upkeep and cart generality remain unproven.

openings.claim: Correct location cannot establish the reservation owner; household surname placement may obscure identity.
openings.discriminator: Existing private evidence independently resolves ownership, or ambiguity persists despite accurate locators.
openings.probe: Review available household reservation evidence before changing handoff rules.
openings.uncertainty: Evidence availability and adequacy are unconfirmed; ownership mismatches may explain second searches.

openings.claim: The concentrated arrival burst may make waiting dominate retrieval delays.
openings.discriminator: Accurate first-location pickups remain late during the burst versus repeated searches dominating elapsed time.
openings.probe: Record arrival, service start, retrieval and completion without changing priority.
openings.uncertainty: Counts establish no waiting duration; timestamp work may itself delay service.

openings.claim: Separate post-opening accounting does not establish the preparation cap.
openings.discriminator: Classify corrections as preparation or service; sum qualifying work without deferral.
openings.probe: Audit existing daily preparation and corrections within remaining allowance before introducing updates.
openings.uncertainty: Upkeep classification remains unsettled; service burden persists even if excluded.

lineage.reason: Locator, cart, identity, queue and accounting relations preserved.
Update benefit, recipient dependency and burden retained.

decision: Audit preparation and identity before capped comparisons. Use only the evening clerk, two shelves/cart; keep names/contact details behind desk; total daily preparation at most ten clerk-minutes. Require 95% available pickups within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. All evidence is synthetic; reader-interview representativeness and presence-uncertainty benefit remain unresolved.
